entity.name: Magisterial District Court 03-3-02
entity.jurisdiction: Civil and criminal matters under MDJ jurisdiction

audits.title: MDJ 03-3-02 Annual Audit FY2024

findings.title: Inadequate Arrest Warrant Documentation Procedures
findings.description: The court failed to maintain adequate documentation for arrest warrants issued. Missing or incomplete documentation was found for 23% of sampled warrants.
findings.recommendation: Implement comprehensive warrant tracking system with mandatory documentation checklist
findings.managementResponse: Court acknowledges finding and will implement new procedures by Q2 2025

findings.title: Cash Receipt Procedures Deficiency
findings.description: Daily cash reconciliation was not performed consistently. 12 days in the audit period lacked proper reconciliation documentation.
findings.recommendation: Ensure daily reconciliation is completed and documented by close of business each day
findings.managementResponse: Corrective action implemented immediately upon notification

recommendations: Provide staff training on documentation requirements

findings.title: Inadequate Arrest Warrant Procedures
findings.description: First occurrence of warrant documentation deficiencies. 18% of sampled warrants had incomplete documentation.
findings.recommendation: Develop and implement warrant tracking procedures

controllerFlags.description: Recurring inadequate arrest warrant procedures - same finding in 2022 and 2024 audits
controllerFlags.requiredAction: Controller review and potential referral to Administrative Office of PA Courts
